summary: @booktoss in all the years I have known you I am not sure I know were your home base is. Either way try to join us for the #IndieWeb summit Jun 29-30th. We have great remote options for this free conference. So glad to have #31DaysIBPOC, sadly my ignorance left me without mentors and models of bloggers to show my students of color. Problem solved.
author: Greg McVerry
